_note: The register of every edge type the medical multigraph may hold. It is a CONTRACT, not documentation: scripts/build_edges.py refuses any edge whose predicate is not registered here, whose subject or object vocabulary is not the one registered, or which has no source (rule zero, docs/weighted-graph-design.md). A new SNOMED CT-AU attribute in a later edition therefore fails the build until someone registers it on purpose. The snomed_attributes section is generated from the release by scripts/graph_register.py; everything else is authored.

_taxonomy._note: Every edge is a verb joining two nouns (concepts). `category` says what kind of meaning the edge carries, after the five-way frame worked out on 23 Sep 2026 -- nouns, verbs, adjectives, temporality, rationality -- extended with the kinds a cross-vocabulary graph needs. Signs and symptoms are NOUNS (SNOMED clinical findings), not adjectives; the adjective layer is the qualifier values that modify them.
_taxonomy.structure: is-a and part-of hierarchy between concepts of one vocabulary (the poly-hierarchy: 42% of standard SNOMED concepts have more than one parent)
_taxonomy.relation: a defining attribute joining two nouns: finding site, associated morphology, causative agent, due to, active ingredient
_taxonomy.action: the 'doing' verb: SNOMED procedure Method (excision, injection ...). LOINC's only verb axis, METHOD, is also action
_taxonomy.adjective: the object is a qualifier value: severity, laterality, interpretation (high/low/normal)
_taxonomy.temporality: occurrence, clinical course, episodicity, temporal context, LOINC TIME
_taxonomy.rationality: quantity: units, pack sizes, LOINC PROPERTY and SCALE. Numeric values themselves are NOT edges -- they live in typed tables (DRUG_STRENGTH, strength); only the unit or the kind of quantity is an edge
_taxonomy.identity: a cross-vocabulary equivalence or mapping: Maps to, exactMatch, xref. Never merges nodes -- the same substance in SNOMED and RxNorm stays two nodes and one identity edge
_taxonomy.commercial: listing and subsidy: PBS item, restriction
_taxonomy.evidence: a clinical assertion from a source: indication, contraindication, off-label use, disease-phenotype. Safety-relevant; defaults to corrected_pending_attestation where a person must sign off

_mechanisms: The five meanings are carried by three different mechanisms, and conflating them is what would sink an implementation: GRAPH EDGES (this register); TYPED TABLES for quantities (DRUG_STRENGTH's 2,966,568 rows, the compendium's strength table -- joins, never traversed); FREE-TEXT FIELDS in sources (PBS severity on 192 of 653 indications, episodicity on 42, 'Severe' and 'severe' distinct strings) which ride as edge attributes until bound.

The bridge is the analyte: the LOINC observable and the Interprets target share a Component and a compatible specimen. Each route (the edge's method) earns its own tier from reference/interprets_handcheck.json: the analyte join 79/80; Athena with the target's specimen 39/40; Athena with a specimen-less target and a blood-family LOINC specimen 40/40 (an assumption that route supplies, so it is scored alone). Unrestricted, Athena's new edges were right 27 times in 53, and are not built; attrs carry the interpretation, the Interprets target, the component and both specimens. Definitional, not diagnostic: DKA is defined partly by a raised glucose, not diagnosed by one.
